title: Session store replicated across nodes with quorum reads and writes
name: Quorum session store

questions.prompt: During a network partition last week, users were told they were logged in and then logged out again once the partition healed. Logins that the API acknowledged had only reached a single node of the session cluster, and later reads returned sessions that were missing or stale. The cluster is supposed to acknowledge writes and serve reads only with a majority of replicas. Fix QuorumStore.java so the tests pass.
